messages:
Maria (plat-pm): quick sync — want alignment on the runtime signals we expose for the new error taxonomy dashboard. goal: single dashboard teams can use to triage spikes (timeouts, 5xx, OOM, degraded-mode/fallbacks).

Alex (eng-platform): +1. main things we need: metric names, labels (model/route/region/tenant), and whether to include retries in counts.

Deepa (eng-runtime): For instrumentation points I propose three emitters: request_handler (ingress), model_runner (inference loop), fallback_controller. Each should tag events with: model, variant, region, route, tenant, routing_policy, seq_len_bucket.

Samir (eng-metrics): watch cardinality. If we include tenant + route + model + variant + region that'll explode. Suggest coarse bucketing for tenant (customer_tier) and seq_len_bucket (short/medium/long).

Jon (eng-sre): Also need to agree semantics: "timeout" = a request that hit runtime timeout SLO vs upstream/client disconnect. OOM should be a separate counter emitted when the model_runner aborts due to OOM and triggers fallback. We should not double-count the subsequent fallback as a timeout.

Deepa (eng-runtime): Good call. Proposed proto-metrics: 
```
reliability.error_count{error_type="timeout", model="gpt-small", region="us-west", route="/v1/chat", fallback="false"} 1
reliability.error_count{error_type="oom", model="gpt-4x", region="eu-central", route="/v1/generate", fallback="true"} 1
reliability.fallback_count{fallback_reason="oom", fallback_to="gpt-quant", region="us-west"} 1
```
We'd emit error_count at the point of failure and fallback_count when fallback flow starts.

Samir (eng-metrics): That layout is fine. Two notes: (1) metric name should be singular/plural-consistent. I prefer reliability.error_events and reliability.fallback_events. (2) add label "phase" (ingress|inference|render) to help root-cause.

Katie (console): For dashboard UX, we want an overview band (total error rate, fallback rate, % of requests in degraded mode) and drilldowns by model/region/route. Also breakpoint widgets for canary vs main rollout. Can we emit rollout_tag label?

Deepa (eng-runtime): We can add rollout_tag label (canary|stable) at request ingress, yes.

Alex (eng-platform): On retries: do we count retries as separate error events? My vote: count the initial failure as an error event, but surface a retry metric: reliability.retry_attempts. That lets SREs see whether retries hide underlying error spikes.

Jon (eng-sre): Agreed. Also need clear guidance on deduping — e.g., OOM -> fallback -> success should show one OOM event + one fallback_event, not a 5xx. And dashboards should display both aggregated and path-aware views.

Maria (plat-pm): Quick PromQL examples for panels so we can validate: 
```
# total error rate (5m)
sum(rate(reliability.error_events[5m])) by (error_type) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))

# fallback count by model
sum(rate(reliability.fallback_events[5m])) by (model)

# OOMs that led to fallback
sum(rate(reliability.error_events{error_type="oom"}[5m])) by (model,region)
```

Samir (eng-metrics): Also emit a histogram for latency excluding fallback paths (so we can compare normal vs degraded). metric: request_duration_seconds_bucket with label fallback="true|false".

Katie (console): For panels: 1) Overview: error rate, fallback rate, % degraded; 2) Top routes causing fallbacks; 3) Heatmap by region/model; 4) Recent traces links. We need trace_id label on error events when available.

Deepa (eng-runtime): We'll attach trace_id when present. Note: sampling for trace_id to avoid cardinality spike (1 in 10 by default).

Maria (plat-pm): Open questions: labeling policy for tenant vs tier, exact seq_len buckets, and rollout_tag convention. Action items next.

Alex (eng-platform): I'll draft a spec for label cardinality limits and route->route_group mapping to keep labels stable.

Samir (eng-metrics): I'll draft metric name normalization + Prometheus exposition format and alert rules for error_rate > 0.5% sustained on top models.

Deepa (eng-runtime): We'll add emitters: request_handler v0.2 (adds rollout_tag, phase, seq_len_bucket) and model_runner v0.3 (oom / latency buckets). ETA: two sprints.

Jon (eng-sre): I'll sketch an FMECA-style mapping for error_type -> suggested runbook and dashboard drill.

Katie (console): I'll prototype dashboard layout in Grafana and share links.

Maria (plat-pm): Nice. Final decision summary so far:
- Metrics: reliability.error_events, reliability.fallback_events, reliability.retry_attempts, request_duration_seconds_bucket
- Labels (recommended): error_type, model, model_variant (opt), region, route_group, routing_policy, customer_tier, rollout_tag, phase, fallback (true/false), trace_id (sampled)
- Semantics: initial failure emits error_event; fallback emits fallback_event; retries increment retry_attempts; don't double-count downstream success as extra errors

sre-bot: Created task INFR-4821: "Expose runtime error events + fallback metrics" assigned to eng-runtime and eng-metrics.

Maria (plat-pm): Thanks all — follow-ups: Alex (label spec), Samir (names + alerts), Deepa (emitters) — aim to review next Tue. :thumbsup:
